rationale: The thesis is intact — price still holds above VWAP ($42.55) and the 9-EMA ($42.71) with relative strength against a weak SPY, and the declared invalidation at $42.69 has not triggered; the last five flat, light-volume candles look like midday digestion just under the $42.77 high rather than distribution. Flip-to-short lacks support since there is no breakdown signal (no lower low, no VWAP loss), and closing now would abandon a defined ~6-cent risk against ~12 cents to the gap fill for no mechanical reason. The disciplined play is to hold and let $42.69 invalidate the trade if the base fails.
